result.topic_en: The page notes the task of expanding a Fourier-type integral into a semiconvergent series in powers of 1/n, gives a simple continuous nowhere-differentiable function defined via quaternary and binary expansions, lists references on continuous maps of a line onto a surface (space-filling curves), and proposes classifying plane curves of order n by their numbers of even and odd real branches.
